profile.name: HyunHo Kim
summary: I believe small differences in user experience shape a product's overall quality.
I turn design intent into code and improve maintainability through reusable components and clear file structures.
I validate critical user flows with Playwright-based end-to-end and unit tests, then start with reproducible conditions when resolving issues.
I automate repetitive work with AI, but always verify the results myself. I believe developers are ultimately responsible for delivering trustworthy outcomes.

highlights.title: KEPCO Contact Center Advisor
items: I designed and implemented the agent and manager frontend from live STT transcription through post-call AI analysis and consultation history.
During the pilot, I trained agents and turned their feedback into name search, favorites, and a dedicated favorites tab.
In an environment averaging about 50,000 calls a day, the system was used by 60% of all agents, and average customer wait time decreased by about 30% after the project entered operation.

highlights.title: OptiGen AI Platform
items: I designed and implemented the frontend and UI/UX from the ground up, including chat, agent settings, conversation history, documents, and administrative features.
I aligned SSE event rules with the backend and connected response generation, MCP tool execution, completion, and error states to the conversation flow.
I connected WebGPU local STT with the meeting-minutes MCP and automated shared-UI verification with 40 Storybook stories and Vitest.

highlights.title: AICC Voice Gateway
items: I implemented an AICC Voice Gateway connecting PBX and SIP integration, per-call Workers, and multiple Voice AI backends.
Transport, Factory, Strategy, and Codec boundaries isolate provider protocol and audio differences.
I implemented VAD-based silence and background-noise handling, DTMF input, call sessions, and reconnection flows.

projects.summary: An OS-style portfolio for the browser that keeps window state, URLs, folder interactions, and preferences in one consistent model.
A B2B AI platform for managing organizations, permissions, AI bots, and documents with RAG-grounded conversations, extended through MCP and Voice Gateway.
An MCP server that connects OptiGen AI to external business APIs and reports progress and results for long-running work such as meeting-minute generation.
A real-time voice gateway connecting PBX and SIP calls with multiple Voice AI backends while isolating provider protocol and audio differences.
A contact-center support system that connects live STT transcription, post-call AI analysis, and call-history search for agents.
An AI-assisted self-study and course management platform supporting dementia prevention programs for Japanese seniors in Vancouver.
A wildfire information PWA combining live maps, risk indicators, news, notifications, and a focused AI chatbot.
